summary: First-finish smoke test for AniJourney AI MVP. All 8 backend endpoints and 7 frontend flows tested end-to-end via public URL. Everything works: seed data (6 anime, 11 locations, 5 characters), JWT auth (register/login/me/favorites), LLM-powered recommend/trip/companion (Claude Sonnet 4.5), Leaflet map with 11 markers, protected /companion route.
passed: POST /api/favorites (with item_type+item_id) and GET /api/favorites work with Bearer token
POST /api/recommend returns 3 valid anime recommendations for 'peaceful like Frieren with mystery' (Frieren, Violet Evergarden, Spirited Away)
POST /api/trip/generate returns itinerary with title, summary, 5 days (day/city/theme/activities), tips
POST /api/companion/chat returns in-character Frieren reply mentioning Kyoto & Fushimi Inari
Landing page loads with cinematic hero + Begin Your Journey CTA
Login form (data-testid=login-form) authenticates and redirects to /explore
Explore page renders anime-grid with 6 anime-card elements
Recommend form submits and renders LLM recommendations inline
/anime/your-name detail page renders with Your Name content
/map renders Leaflet with exactly 11 red markers over Japan
/planner: selecting anime + clicking planner-generate-btn produces itinerary-result
/companion (protected) accessible post-login; selecting Frieren + sending message returns in-character LLM reply
notes: Favorites endpoint schema requires {item_type, item_id} — matches server.py contract. LLM latency 5-12s per call as expected. test_credentials.md present and used.
